_comment: Variants tracked by the shadow dashboard. Each entry is one bot config
evaluated independently against the same real market data.
TO TEST A TWEAK: copy a block, give it a distinct label, change the
Because every run replays the full history, a new variant gets the whole
back-history immediately -- you do not wait months to compare it.
To make the daily job use this file, add --variants to the shadow step in
.github/workflows/tradingbot-shadow.yml. Without it the four defaults run.
label               unique name shown on the dashboard
risk_per_trade_pct  fraction of equity risked per trade (0.02 = 2%)
params              strategy-specific overrides (see the strategy class)
A reminder from Rep 7: a change that only wins on one sample is noise.
Judge a variant on whether it holds up, not on a single good number.

variants._example: Half risk. Rep 4 found donchian breaches the 5% weekly limit at 2% risk, so this is the safer way to run it. Delete the leading underscore in the keys below to activate.
variants.label: donchian_1pct

variants._example: Slower EMA pair — fewer whipsaws, later entries.
variants.label: ema_slow_16_60

variants._example: Tighter trailing stop: banks winners sooner, gives back less at the top, but exits trends earlier. NOTE atr_trail_mult belongs in params (the strategy owns the trail), not in risk.
variants.label: ema_tight_trail

variants._example: Concentrate into fewer, larger positions. max_positions IS a RiskConfig field, so it goes in the risk block.
variants.label: ema_max2_positions
